records.name: Willing Hearts
records.description: Free meal assistance by social-service referral. The kitchen coordinates delivery; it is not a confirmed public collection point.
records.eligibility: Ask a social worker or social service agency to apply. For help finding care support, AIC lists 1800 650 6060. Current beneficiary criteria and delivery times need confirmation.
records.verification_notes: Website-source review only; no provider contact or live stock check. Archived FoodConnect facts are not reverified. The soup-kitchen address is operational/coordination information, not evidence of public meal pickup. Do not map as a collection point. The source says kitchen operations year-round, but it does not give meal dispatch times or beneficiary schedule. The current Willing Hearts page prints the AIC contact as 1800 6560 5050; AIC?s official contact page instead lists 1800-650-6060. Do not repeat the Willing Hearts-rendered number as an AIC hotline. AIC?s number is independently verified as its general public hotline, not specifically as a food-aid intake line. Unconfirmed: Current beneficiary eligibility and meal suitability/diet; Exact beneficiary delivery locations and timings; Whether public pickup is available (no public collection point confirmed); Current page has obfuscated addresses for general and meal enquiries, so the exact programme-specific email was not machine-readable in the rendered public source; the provider-controlled 2023/24 annual report lists willingheartsingapore@gmail.com, which is a historical confirmation only

records.name: Yong-en Care Centre
records.description: Food-ration support for residents around Chinatown. Older reports describe monthly rations; ask about current delivery or arranged collection.
records.eligibility: Food-ration referrals come through an SSO or FSC for residents in the Chinatown vicinity. Confirm current assessment and service coverage with Yong-en.
records.verification_notes: Website-source review only; no provider contact or live stock check. Archived FoodConnect facts are not reverified. The 2025 publication reports FY2024 activities; state its period rather than implying independently reverified live 2026 cadence. Do not use the administrative centre address as a food pickup location. BreadWalk and FreshFood are separate food-security activities, not evidence for the FoodConnect ration card's exact delivery details. Unconfirmed: Exact current collection address and session times; Whether home delivery is available to all eligible beneficiaries or only by individual arrangement; Dietary suitability; current programme sources say dry rations but do not establish halal status

source_notes: The raw official response includes 22 provider records; source page footer states last updated 22 Mar 2023. Per-row timestamps are preserved and can differ.
Directory facts are source-card values, not current availability, stock, eligibility approval, or guaranteed service. The FoodConnect FAQ says eligibility varies by provider.

Provider-reviewed status means a current or recent organization source confirmed relevant programme/contact information; it does not validate every FoodConnect field. Directory-only means programme facts have not been independently corroborated by an organization-controlled source.
No unpublished intake information, hours, diet, accessibility, or service address is inferred. Unknown locations remain null.
permission: Public information transcribed from the Government of Singapore FoodConnect directory for internal review. This is not a partner export or a grant of redistribution rights. Do not treat directory details as current stock, eligibility approval, or confirmed access without provider confirmation.

coverage.listing_scope: All rows from the site's public directory data endpoint response; response contained 22 provider records in one array. Raw response and response headers are archived under backend/data/foodconnect-sources/.
coverage.record_timestamps: Per-record timestamp is retained verbatim as source_record_timestamp_raw; formats differ and one row may use an Excel-serial-like value.
coverage.source_fact_mapping: Public provider/card summary, description, contact, email, website, supportType; each supportType's *Info frequency, recipients, dietaryPreference, deliveryMethod and regions; corresponding raw *Frequency, *Recipients, *Types, *DeliveryMethod, *EstateGroup and *DistributionDays/*DistributionDates values (including null versus blank); and public aggregate fields are retained under directory_facts. No PK/SK, agreement, internal download status, named contact person, logo metadata, internal request contact, or internal references are included.
coverage.coordinates: Null except Krsna's confirmed provider-published public meal-service address, geocoded using OneMap. Other provider office/HQ addresses are not assumed to be service or pickup points.
